title: feat(app-shell,plugin-detail,components,i18n): the record page's timeline and related columns are each reader's per-object switches, toggled from the crumb row
body:
Fixes #27052
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：记录页的「时间线」「关联」两列变成读者自己的开关，按对象记住；默认值从对象推导（被工作的对象开时间线，否则关），不是元数据。crumb 行右侧多了一组图标开关（☴ 时间线 ⌘⇧T、⊞ 关联 ⌘⇧R），关掉时间线时它的内容折进关联列底部的「动态」卡。
- **为什么改**：维护者裁决「时间线是否显示，是否可以切换……顶部有很多切换图标」——产品、价格表这类对象的中间列是一条空的流和一个输入框。
- **风险与回滚**：只动前端（app-shell / plugin-detail / components / i18n），无 spec、无元数据键；回滚即 revert 本 PR。偏好存在浏览器 localStorage，回滚后旧键残留无害。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordPageColumns.ts`（默认值推导与排布规则）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`（crumb 行与快捷键）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/workspacePreference.ts`（偏好存储）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.panelToggles-27052.test.tsx`，预期 6 passed；或看下方证据分支的三张截图。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位已裁两条 open questions（见下方 Resolved）并落地。

## What changes

- **One workspace-preference store (`app-shell/src/utils/workspacePreference.ts`).** A preference is declared once and read per scope: `user`, or `object:OBJECT_NAME`. Each preference and scope pair has one `localStorage` key. The value is a small JSON record carrying `v`, and a record of another version reads as "no choice". Reads are live through `useSyncExternalStore`, other tabs arrive through the `storage` event, and with no storage (SSR, a blocked origin, a refused write) a read falls back to the default while a refused choice is held for the page.
- **`recordOpenPreference` is a thin alias over it.** Its key `os:record-open-mode` and its bare `drawer` / `split` spelling are unchanged, so a reader's earlier choice reads back and the record-open preference tests pass unchanged.
- **Two new preferences.** `record.columns.timeline` and `record.columns.related` take `on` / `off` per object. With no choice, `recordPageColumnDefaults` derives the default: the timeline is on for a worked object and off otherwise, and the related column is on. `recordTimelineDefaultReason` names the branch: `stageField` names a field, a field's options declare a lifecycle `kind` (unless `stageField: false`), or `enable.files: true`. Being the `master_detail` parent of another object is not a signal (seat ruling 1, PR comment 6464903026): a container that owns child rows is not a worked record. The derivation reads only the object itself, so `recordTimelineDefaultReason` / `recordPageColumnDefaults` take no object list.
- **The column tiers read the switches.** `recordPageArrangementFor(tier, switches)` is the rule, and `RecordPageColumns` takes `switches`. With the timeline off, a wide page draws details | related and the timeline's blocks become an Activity card at the foot of the related column. With related off, the related column stays behind the existing rail toggle. Below the column widths the page is tabbed as before, the switches are kept, and `?tab=` is untouched. Authored `kind: full` pages and `slots.tabs` never reach this code.
- **`PanelToggles` (`@object-ui/components`).** It is a named group of icon toggles with `aria-pressed`, a tinted pressed state and a tooltip showing the shortcut's keycaps. The related switch is named `detail.relatedColumn` (「关联列」), apart from the rail toggle and the Related tab, so the row never carries two controls named 「关联」. The record page draws it on its crumb row, right side, only in a column tier. It is not drawn in the drawer or split pane.
- **Shortcuts.** `⌘⇧.` / `Ctrl+Shift+.` (timeline) and `⌘⇧,` / `Ctrl+Shift+,` (related) flip the switches while the full record page is in a column tier — matched by physical key (`KeyboardEvent.code` `Period` / `Comma`), since Shift changes the character those keys type. The card's `⌘⇧T` / `⌘⇧R` are browser-reserved (reopen closed tab, hard reload) and were replaced by seat ruling 2; a `⌘⇧T` / `⌘⇧R` keydown now leaves the columns and the stored preference untouched. They do nothing while a text field has focus, and they are advertised to the keyboard-shortcuts dialog under the same gate.
- **i18n.** `detail.timeline`, `detail.timelineFolded`, `detail.relatedColumn`, `detail.panelToggles`, `console.shortcuts.toggleTimeline` and `console.shortcuts.toggleRelated` are added in all ten packs; no pack names a chord.

### Merge order with the record-page navigation PR

The navigation PR for the record page, objectstack-ai/objectstack#27038, adds ↑ ↓ and a back link to the same crumb row. This PR does not depend on it. Whichever lands second places its controls so the row reads ↑ ↓ · divider · panel toggles. The first to land does not wait for the other.

## Tests

- `workspacePreference.test.ts` covers keys per preference and scope, the versioned record, unreadable spellings, no storage and SSR. `workspacePreference.hook.test.tsx` covers the live hook: same-scope callers re-render, scopes stay apart, cross-tab `storage` events arrive, and a refusing storage holds the choice for the page.
- `recordPageColumns.switches-27052.test.ts` has one row per derivation branch and per arrangement case. `RecordPageColumns.switches-27052.test.tsx` checks where each block lands when a column is off.
- `panel-toggles.test.tsx` covers the group name, `aria-pressed`, the tint class, click behaviour and the tooltip keycaps.
- `RecordDetailView.panelToggles-27052.test.tsx` mounts the real view. It covers the card's acceptance 1: timeline off on a worked object draws details | related with the folded card, and on restores it. The choice survives a remount and is per object. An object that is not worked opens with the timeline off. `⌘⇧T` with an input focused does nothing. Nothing is drawn in the tabbed tier or when embedded.
- `recordOpenPreference.test.ts` and the two `ObjectView` record-open suites pass unchanged (acceptance 3).

## Acceptance notes

- **Screenshots (acceptance 2).** They were taken on HotCRM `f660fd8`, fresh DB, with this branch's console at 1720 px wide. HotCRM's `crm_lead` carries an authored `kind: 'full'` record page, which the card leaves untouched, so the column tiers never draw there. The worked-object shots therefore use `crm_contact`, which has `enable.files: true` and no authored page. Evidence branch (never merge): `claude/issue-27052-evidence`, folder `evidence-27052/`.
  - `1-contact-both-columns.png`: three columns and both toggles pressed.
  - `1b-contact-toggle-tooltip.png`: the tooltip with its keycaps.
  - `2-contact-timeline-off.png`: details | related.
  - `3-product-default.png`: `crm_product` opens as details | related, with the timeline folded at the foot of the related column.
  - A browser readback on that run confirmed three more things. The contact's choice survived a reload. `Ctrl+Shift+T` sent by Playwright turned the timeline back on (that run predates ruling 2; the chord is now `Ctrl+Shift+.`, pinned in `panelToggles-27052`, not re-measured in a real browser: Playwright injects keys below the browser's accelerator layer). The root measured 1464 px.
- **The drawer width is not yet read through the store.** The card asked for the `ov:drawer-width:OBJECT` key to go through the store too. That read and write live in `navigation-overlay.tsx`, which this dispatch fences off because the navigation PR edits it. It is left for after that PR lands.
- **⌘K.** The command palette on main has no command registry. `CommandPaletteProvider` only opens and closes it, and `CommandPalette` hard-codes its groups. So this PR adds the shortcuts and no palette commands.
- **Two private helpers repeated.** The chord matcher and the text-field check repeat `AppHeader`'s, which are private to that file. Sharing them would edit a file outside this card's surface.
- **New preferences only carry `v`.** The record-open preference keeps its bare stored value without `v`, because its tests pin the stored bytes.

### HotCRM reading of the default derivation

Read with `recordPageColumnDefaults` over the 20 object definitions of HotCRM `f660fd8`, loaded from source, on head `fd0f941f70` (after ruling 1):

| object | timeline | branch |
|:---|:---|:---|
| crm_lead, crm_opportunity, crm_task, crm_case | ON | option-kinds |
| crm_account, crm_contact, crm_contract, crm_quote | ON | files |
| crm_campaign, crm_price_book, crm_event, crm_knowledge_article, crm_product, crm_forecast, crm_opportunity_line_item, crm_quote_line_item, crm_price_book_entry, crm_campaign_member, crm_event_attendee, crm_article_feedback | OFF | none |

8 ON / 12 OFF; the related column defaults to ON for all 20. This matches the card's expected list exactly. Before ruling 1 the four container objects (campaign, price book, event, knowledge article) were ON through a `master_detail`-parent branch that is now gone.

### Open questions — resolved by the seat (PR comment 6464903026), both landed in patch round 1

1. **The master_detail-parent branch: B, dropped.** A container that owns child rows is not a worked record (ruling 2 on the card); every object the card expects ON stays ON through stage kinds or files; the rule reads two declared signals of the object itself. Pinned by a view-level case (an object that is only another object's `master_detail` parent opens with the timeline off) and the HotCRM table above.
2. **Chords: B, moved off the browser's.** `⌘⇧.` / `⌘⇧,` (`Ctrl+Shift+.` / `Ctrl+Shift+,`), matched by physical key; tooltip keycaps, `aria-keyshortcuts` and the shortcuts dialog read the same constants. Delivery through a real browser's accelerator layer is NOT MEASURED on this host (Playwright and devtools inject below it); the page-side behaviour is pinned.

## Verification

Final head `fd0f941f70`. Cloud run: report comment 6464041380 on the card (34 / 34 derived gates exit 0 on `b36136e2`, ablation of the typing-target guard). Patch round 1 (local, user-token pushes): report comment 6466430387 (34 / 34 gates on `a6d6ac6fb4` with the list re-derived identical on `fd0f941f70`; 634 files / 6348 tests across plugin-detail, i18n, components custom, app-shell utils / chrome / RecordDetailView* / ObjectView*; plugin-detail + app-shell type-check with their test tsconfigs; two reverse verifications with blob hashes and a clean `git diff HEAD`). CI on `fd0f941f70`: Test UI 17 / 17 shards, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI all success.
